annotations.title: Distance and bearing between two points

description: How far apart are two places (in any coordinate format), and in which direction? Precise WGS84 distance in m, km, mi, nmi and ft, initial and final bearing and the midpoint. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

inputFormat.description: Skip auto-detection: latlon (dd/dms/ddm), utm, ups, mgrs, pluscode, geohash, maidenhead.

order.description: For letterless numbers: latlon (default) or lonlat. Hemisphere letters and lat/lon labels win.

ref.description: Reference point for short plus codes (in the input, and to add a short code to the output), like "40.4,-79.9".

name: distance_between_points
title: Distance and bearing between two points
